face.text: Battlecry: Transform another random minion into a 5/5 Devilsaur or a 1/1 Squirrel.
face.flavorText: Tinkmaster Overspark nearly lost his Tinker's license after the Great Ironforge Squirrel Stampede of '09.

face.flavorText: 钢铁战蝎守护着奥格瑞玛，并在最近刚获得“月度最佳员工”称号！

face.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Shuffle a Mine into your opponent's deck. When drawn, explode for 10 damage!
face.flavorText: The Iron Juggernaut guards Orgrimmar and has just earned the "Employee of the Month" award!

face.text: 每当一个敌方随从死亡，召唤一个 麻风侏儒。
face.flavorText: 过去他非常执迷于炸药。而现在他更加关怀麻风侏儒们的生计，因为他们能够造成更稳定的伤害。

face.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
face.text: Whenever an enemy minion dies, summon a Leper Gnome.
face.flavorText: He was obsessed with explosives until he discovered knitting. Now he yells, “SWEATERS! MORE SWEATERS!”

face.flavorText: He really just wants to be your friend, but the constant rejection is starting to really get to him.

face.name: 发条侏儒
face.text: 亡语：将一张零件牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 发条侏儒总是会问：“现在几点？”因为他需要有人定时帮他旋紧发条。

face.name: Clockwork Gnome
face.text: Deathrattle: Add a Spare Part card to your hand.
face.flavorText: Clockwork gnomes are always asking what time it is.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies: Toshley battlecry and deathrattle reuse the actual original Clockwork Gnome seven-Part producer; all seven original effects and metadata remain exact.

Tinkmaster uniformly selects one original other active living ordinary minion, then uniformly selects one of its two complete real Beast forms; guarded transformation preserves the original target residence and uses shared lifecycle.
Both Juggernaut original client rows link to dbf2221 Mine; retain their distinct roots and execute their shared real named child rather than infer from names.
Actual shuffled insertion uses the public semantic shuffle request with original actor and opponent recipient, on both battlecry and actual deathrattle.
Mine is its actual6-mana original noncollectible cast-when-drawn spell; self10 ordinary SPELL damage and shared replacement-draw policy, normal hand play has no replacement draw.
Thermaplugg binds each actual enemy minion death record and summons the existing complete original EX1_029 through ordinary capacity and summon delivery.
uncertainties: Exact CN random target/form ordering, full shuffle insertion knowledge and trigger acceptance windows follow existing local policies pending calibration.
Mine uses existing ordinary SPELL damage and shared cast-when-drawn replacement semantics, including modifiers of its actual drawer; exact CN exceptions remain a deferred rule boundary.
No partial MIS_701 source binding or implemented-subset pool; all732 original identities and the other goal domains/version/hotfix/CN edges remain open.
